theorems.name: Submission.smr_ufd_small_cutoff
theorems.statement: ∀ (P : ℕ) (U : Set (Eucl P)) (μ : Measure (Eucl P)), (∀ K : Set (Eucl P), IsCompact K → K ⊆ U → μ K < ∞) → ∀ C W : Set (Eucl P), IsCompact C → IsOpen W → C ⊆ W → W ⊆ U → ∀ ε : ℝ≥0∞, ε ≠ 0 → ∃ ψ : Eucl P → ℝ, Continuous ψ ∧ HasCompactSupport ψ ∧ tsupport ψ ⊆ W ∧ (∀ x, 0 ≤ ψ x ∧ ψ x ≤ 1) ∧ (∀ x ∈ C, ψ x = 1) ∧ μ (Function.support ψ \ C) < ε
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
